summary: @ornikar/babel-preset-kitt-universal preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's declared preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime zip from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods the binary 0o755, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')], {cwd: D})` against a 727 KB heavily obfuscated JS file shipped in the tarball. math_init.js begins with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and contains a rotated string-array decoder (`function WV8StW(...)`) with hex-named identifiers; it is not referenced by lib/index.js and is only reachable through the preinstall dropper. A Babel preset has no legitimate need for the Bun runtime, and the executed code is an opaque blob the installer cannot review before it runs. Installing this package auto-executes attacker-selected obfuscated code on the installer's machine under a dropped alternate runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
